statements.statement: The insurance representative estimated a 10 percent increase for active health plans and advised budgeting 8 to 10 percent for five years.
The levy for budgeting is 2.5 percent over the prior levy, with the delayed value certification possibly affecting the tax rate timing.
About this much ARPA money remains after the committed ambulance and two DPW trucks.

warnings.prediction: Health insurance costs are expected to keep rising in the next five years because of medical trends and hospital contract renegotiations.
